title: contractFindings
responsibility: Compares documented inputs, defaults, errors and outputs against the existing source contract and recognises state descriptions without executing source.

inputs.name: contractFindings.unit
inputs.description: The stored unit whose contract is the documented side of the comparison, with its id as each finding's entity. Only id, title, runtime.entry and contract are read, so other manifest fields never change the findings.

examples.title: contractFindings
examples.responsibility: Compares documented inputs, defaults, errors and outputs against the existing source contract and recognises state descriptions without executing source.

inputs.name: documentsState.items
inputs.description: The documented contract items whose name, type and description text is searched for the state. Only those three text fields are read, so required, default and other properties never affect the result.

examples.name: documentsState
examples.description: True when the state appears as a whole word in the names, types or descriptions of the items, and for failed the words failure and fail also count; otherwise false. Required and default values are never searched.

examples.name: documentsState.items
examples.description: Documented contract items whose text is searched for the state.

inputs.name: documentsState.state
inputs.description: The state word to find as a whole word in the item text, compared case-insensitively, and the exact value failed also matches failure and fail. Text is split on anything other than ASCII letters, digits and hyphens, so a state with spaces or other punctuation never matches, and an empty state is not rejected.

outputs.name: contractFindings
outputs.description: Findings of the kinds missing-required, missing-default, missing-errors, missing-output and undocumented-prop, each carrying entity, kind, detail and where. Exact duplicates are removed, so an empty array means none of these checks produced a finding.

examples.detail: documentsState.state is optional without a documented default (including explicit null).

outputs.name: contractScopes
outputs.description: The root scope with an empty name, followed by one scope per operation, initializer and snippet, in that order, each named by its item. Each scope keeps only its own inputs, outputs and errors, so the root's inputs are never combined with an operation's.
